findings: `summary.text` and `learner.overview.text` describe 牛 as a picture of an ox’s head and horns without limiting that interpretation to the early forms. Qualify the description as an interpretation of the early graph: the cited sources support the head-and-horns analysis for inscriptional forms, while the selected glyph is a modern rendering of a later seal-style form (X-fdae8253f105c45b2db4, X-1f015cca760f7a9975ea, X-88867ce0ef91673af771, X-3d83fe29011da29bea7f).
